name: Vul4J public Java patch contexts

limitations: No semantic or general near-duplicate detection
Labels and source licences require human verification

split_rule: Index modulo 5 in the cohort's fixed seed-17 SHA256-ranked repository-component ledger; test bucket 2, validation bucket 3
selection: VUL4J-1 through VUL4J-79; retrievable single-commit patches, explicit permissive licences, nonempty changed production Java contexts; no performance-based filtering

pairs.failing_tests: org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec %De],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec IMMUNE_PERCENT (%)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (!)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS ($)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (*)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (+)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (-)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (.)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (=)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (?)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (@)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (^)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (_)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (|)],org.OWASP.esapi.codecs.CodecImmunityTest#testImmuneEncode[PercentCodec Full_ALPHA_AND_SPECIALS (~)]

view_meaning: No source transformation or augmentation robustness experiment was performed
labels: 1=before documented correction, 0=after correction for the listed CVE; patch context rather than complete-program ground truth
near_duplicate_rule: Join repositories for shared CVE, identical comment/whitespace-free lexical context, or >=0.90 Jaccard overlap of token 5-grams (minimum 25 unique grams)
limits: Heuristic near-duplicate checks do not prove semantic independence
Original upstream PoVs were not re-executed
Balanced patch pairs do not represent vulnerability prevalence
Repository separation does not establish separation from CodeBERT pretraining
